description: This file defines the MembershipDao class responsible for database operations related to 'Membership' entities in the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods for CRUD operations, searching, and pagination of memberships.

classes.name: MembershipDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for managing Membership entities, providing persistence, retrieval, and deletion operations.

methods.name: saveMembership
methods.description: Persists a Membership entity in the database and returns the saved entity.

methods.name: getMembershipById
methods.description: Fetches a Membership by its ID, returning null if not found.

methods.name: getExistingMembershipIds
methods.description: Retrieves IDs of existing Memberships matching a list of provided IDs.

methods.name: getMembershipByName
methods.description: Finds a Membership by its name after trimming whitespace.

methods.name: getMembershipList
methods.description: Returns a list of memberships based on filter parameters, utilizing pagination.

methods.name: getMembershipListPaginator
methods.description: Returns a Paginator object configured with filter, sorting, and pagination params.

methods.name: getMembershipCount
methods.description: Counts the number of memberships matching the filter parameters.

methods.name: deleteMemberships
methods.description: Deletes memberships with specified IDs and returns the number of deletions.

methods.name: isExistingMembershipName
methods.description: Checks if a given membership name already exists.
